description: This source file 'instance_manager.h' defines the declaration of the `InstanceManager` class within the 'cuttlefish' namespace. The class manages instances and instance groups, including creation, removal, and retrieval, and handles related operations such as acquiring locks and stopping instances. It also includes various external dependencies relevant to instance management, locking, and command handling.
